wiki_text: In March 2025, Botala Energy signed a binding letter of intent with SCAW South Africa for an anchor LNG offtake of up to 3.5 PJ per annum in Phase 1, expandable to 4.7 PJ/a, and commenced a bankable feasibility study for an up-to-3.5 PJ/a LNG plant. In March 2026, Botala spudded its first commercial CBM production well, Serowe-3.5B, the centrepiece of the Pitse pilot program. As of early 2026 the company targeted a final investment decision in the second half of 2026, with first LNG delivery anticipated in 2027. The government-owned Minerals Development Company Botswana has proposed an equity investment (increased to BWP35 million, about a 15% stake plus a 1% royalty on future LNG production).
